name: Procedural Sphere Placement
definition: Populates a 3D voxel grid with spherical voids (density 0) inside a background field (density 255), using pre-sampled 2D coordinates and random radii.
summary: Procedural Sphere Placement populates a 3D voxel grid with hard-edged spherical voids using random radii, differing from single-sphere carving by automating multiple placements.
